metadata.title: DVC AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from DVC Governance Benchmark

components.title: DVC
components.description: AI/ML component for DVC with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every governed dataset version is tracked in DVC and linked to Git history

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track all datasets used for training, validation, and testing with DVC so each dataset version is reproducible, attributable, and recoverable from Git-linked metadata.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed datasets with DVC tracking metadata, Git linkage, and remote reference / total governed datasets in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure dataset-lineage completeness reaches 100% before any dataset is approved for training or evaluation use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC is designed to version datasets and link them to code history, making provenance a primary framework-native control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure train, validation, and test split integrity is versioned and validated

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track dataset partitions with DVC and validate that no unapproved overlap, duplication, or contamination exists across governed splits before training.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Duplicate rate, train-test overlap rate, contamination rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute overlap and duplicate statistics across the DVC-tracked splits and reject versions that exceed the approved contamination threshold.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure train-test overlap and contamination rates remain below threshold for every approved dataset version.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC does not compute contamination directly, but it provides the dataset version control needed for repeatable split validation.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure subgroup representation metrics are attached to each governed dataset version

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For datasets used in AI development, store subgroup coverage evidence alongside DVC-tracked dataset versions so underrepresentation can be reviewed before training.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Coverage ratio, class imbalance ratio, subgroup sample proportion

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute subgroup proportions for each dataset version and compare them to the approved representativeness target or expected production distribution.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup coverage remains within approved representativeness thresholds before a dataset version is approved.

props.name: Threshold_Value
props.value: No subgroup below 80% of expected coverage

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC is relevant because it preserves the exact dataset version for which fairness and representativeness evidence was produced.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed data changes require new DVC versions and reproducibility evidence

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require every material dataset change to produce a new DVC-tracked version and updated benchmark evidence before that data is used in training.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = material dataset changes with new DVC version and linked approval evidence / total material dataset changes in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-change coverage reaches 100% for all governed data updates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC's versioning model is a direct fit for controlled change management of training and evaluation data.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure model artifacts are versioned and linked to the exact data, code, and parameters used to produce them

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track model artifacts with DVC pipelines so every model can be traced to its source data versions, pipeline stages, code revisions, and parameter values.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = model artifacts with linked code, data, params, stage definitions, and metrics / total governed model artifacts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model-lineage completeness reaches 100% before any model artifact is approved for release or comparison.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC pipelines and experiment tracking are designed to tie artifacts back to dependencies and params, making lineage one of the strongest control areas.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure benchmark metrics are versioned and compared for every experiment candidate

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record experiment metrics in DVC and compare them across candidate runs so models with degraded task quality are not silently promoted.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, exact match, perplexity

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run approved evaluation benchmarks and store metrics in DVC-tracked outputs; compare each candidate to the approved baseline or champion experiment.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, Exact Match, Perplexity

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure candidate quality metrics deviate by no more than 10% from the approved Hugging Face model-card baseline or internal champion baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC supports experiment tracking and metric comparison, making this a central release-gating use case.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every approved experiment can be reproduced from versioned code, data, and parameters

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use DVC stages and experiment tracking so approved experiments can be rerun and reproduce materially similar outputs within the accepted variance window.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Reproducibility rate = experiments successfully rerun from tracked dependencies / total approved experiments tested; repeated-run variance is computed across reruns.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure experiment reproducibility remains above threshold and repeated-run variance stays within the approved tolerance.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC explicitly promotes reproducible ML projects and experiment reruns, so this is a framework-native control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure parameter changes are tracked and comparable across all governed experiments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track hyperparameters and configuration files used in experiments so unexplained model changes can be traced to specific parameter deltas.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = experiments with complete tracked parameter files and change history / total governed experiments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure parameter-lineage completeness reaches 100% for all approved experiments.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC experiment comparison depends on versioned params, making parameter traceability a direct governance control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every stage in the ML pipeline is declared with explicit dependencies and outputs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use DVC pipelines so transformations from raw data to features, training artifacts, metrics, and models are explicitly represented and versioned.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed workflows with all required stages, deps, params, and outputs declared in DVC / total governed workflows.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure pipeline-declaration completeness reaches 100% before workflow approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC's stage graph is one of its strongest controls for process transparency and reproducibility.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure downstream artifacts are rebuilt whenever tracked upstream dependencies change

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use DVC's dependency graph so feature, model, and metric artifacts are regenerated whenever governed upstream code, data, or parameters change.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Stale-artifact rate = artifacts whose upstream dependencies changed without rebuild / total governed artifacts sampled in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure stale-artifact rate remains below threshold across all governed pipelines.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC's core value is that dependency changes determine what must be rebuilt, directly reducing stale-artifact risk.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure DVC remotes are synchronized with approved local cache states

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that required data and model objects exist in the configured remote so reproducibility and collaboration do not fail due to missing remote artifacts.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Remote-sync success = successful push or pull validations / total tested sync operations; missing-object rate = missing required objects / total required objects sampled.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure remote-sync success remains above threshold and missing-object rate remains below threshold for governed remotes.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC's reproducibility claims depend on the availability of cache objects in configured remotes.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Unauthorized access to tracked data or models

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure DVC remotes used for governed artifacts are access-controlled and approved

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Restrict governed DVC remotes to approved storage endpoints with documented access controls and ownership.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed projects using only approved remotes / total governed projects in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-remote coverage reaches 100% for all governed DVC projects.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Core DVC supports many remote backends, so remote-governance is a practical control even though enforcement may live outside DVC itself.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure fairness benchmark results are tracked and compared across experiments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Store fairness evaluation outputs with DVC-tracked experiments so subgroup disparities can be compared before model selection or promotion.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Demographic parity difference, subgroup error rate, CrowS-Pairs or BBQ score

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute approved fairness metrics and compare experiment results against the accepted fairness baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup disparity remains below threshold and fairness benchmark scores do not materially regress versus the approved baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC is relevant because it preserves the exact experiment context for fairness comparisons across versions.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: PII leakage in experiment outputs or tracked artifacts

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed experiment outputs are checked for PII before they are versioned or shared

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate metrics files, reports, samples, or serialized artifacts so sensitive personal data is not inadvertently versioned through DVC workflows.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = versioned artifacts containing seeded or identified PII / total governed artifacts tested; compute precision and recall for the privacy detection process when used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII leakage rate remains below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before artifacts are shared or promoted.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC can version non-model artifacts too, so privacy governance must include outputs, reports, and samples.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Toxic output regression across model candidates

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxicity benchmark results are tracked across release candidates

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Store toxicity evaluation outputs in DVC experiments so harmful-generation regressions are visible during candidate comparison.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute toxicity metrics over the approved evaluation suite and compare each candidate experiment to the approved baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure average toxicity and toxic-output rate remain below approved thresholds for release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC is the versioning and comparison layer rather than the evaluator, but it is well suited to preserving this evidence across experiments.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hallucination and faithfulness metrics are compared across model candidates

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track faithfulness and hallucination benchmark results in DVC so semantic quality regressions are visible across experiment versions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute approved hallucination or faithfulness metrics and compare each candidate experiment to the baseline experiment.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and hallucination rate remains below threshold for approved candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is especially useful for generative model workflows where DVC is used to compare experiments locally and via Git-linked collaboration.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Promotion of unsupported or weak factuality models

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure factuality and unsupported-claim metrics are versioned for every governed release candidate

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track factuality benchmark outputs so model candidates with excessive unsupported claims are not selected without evidence.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Unsupported-claim rate = unsupported claims / total claims; factuality score from the approved evaluation benchmark for each candidate.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unsupported-claim rate remains below threshold and factuality remains above threshold for release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC helps preserve the evidence trail used to justify model promotion decisions.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Experiment result drift due to uncontrolled environments

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure environment assumptions are versioned with governed experiments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track environment files, dependency manifests, and execution assumptions so experiment outcomes can be rerun under materially similar conditions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = experiments with tracked environment manifests and dependency references / total governed experiments; repeated-run variance from rerun comparison.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure environment-lineage completeness reaches 100% and repeated-run variance remains within the approved tolerance.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC focuses on reproducibility, and environment drift is one of the main reasons reproducibility fails in practice.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Metrics or plots not tied to the correct artifact version

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure metrics and plots are generated from the same tracked artifact versions used in evaluation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require DVC metric and plot outputs to be generated only from the exact data and model versions declared in the governed pipeline.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Correctness rate = evaluated metrics and plots linked to the declared artifact versions / total reviewed metrics and plots.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure metric-artifact linkage correctness remains above threshold for all release evidence.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC supports tracked metrics and plots, so tying them to the right artifact version is a legitimate integrity control.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Lost collaboration reproducibility due to missing pushes

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed experiments and artifact versions are pushed to approved remotes before collaboration or promotion

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require data and model objects needed to reproduce governed experiments to exist in approved remotes before sharing, review, or release promotion.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Readiness = governed experiments with all required objects available in approved remotes / total governed experiments marked for collaboration or review.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure collaboration-readiness reaches 100% before experiments are shared for review or release decisions.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC supports local-first experiment tracking, but collaboration still depends on remote object availability.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure pipeline stage reuse is validated so unchanged stages are not recomputed unnecessarily

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use DVC's dependency graph and stage caching behavior to confirm that governed pipelines only rerun steps impacted by actual changes.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Stage-reuse rate = unchanged stages correctly reused / total unchanged stages; unnecessary-rerun rate = unchanged stages rerun / total unchanged stages.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unchanged stages are reused at the approved rate and unnecessary reruns remain below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This aligns directly with DVC's pipeline value proposition of rerunning only impacted steps.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed DVC projects cover quality, fairness, privacy, robustness, reproducibility, and lineage tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a DVC release standard that requires experiment comparison and reproducibility evidence across core risk domains instead of checking only headline performance metrics.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated risk domains with active tracked evidence / total mandated risk domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure governed DVC projects maintain risk-test coverage at or above threshold across required validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC is valuable as the evidence and reproducibility layer for release testing across multiple risk domains.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every governed DVC project documents remotes, pipelines, metrics, params, and collaboration assumptions

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document the project's remote storage design, tracked artifacts, metrics, parameters, reproducibility assumptions, and review workflow before promotion to governed use.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required project transparency fields / total required fields in the approved checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure project transparency completeness reaches 100% before governed production use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Because DVC spans data, pipelines, experiments, and remotes, transparent project configuration is necessary for reviewability.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure released models linked through DVC have complete model-card-style documentation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Attach intended use, limitations, dataset scope, evaluation benchmarks, fairness results, and deployment assumptions to any model released through a DVC-governed workflow.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required fields for each released model.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model transparency completeness reaches 100% before release approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC often manages model artifacts in ML projects, so model-card completeness remains relevant even though DVC is not itself the model framework.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Promotion of unsafe model candidate due to missing comparison evidence

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure candidate selection decisions are backed by tracked benchmark comparisons

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require DVC experiment comparison evidence to justify why a candidate model was selected over alternatives on governed quality and safety benchmarks.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = promoted candidates with complete tracked benchmark comparison evidence / total promoted candidates in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure selection-evidence completeness reaches 100% for all promoted candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC's comparison features are directly relevant to transparent candidate selection and release review.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Version mismatch between code, data, and model during reproduction

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure reproduction uses a self-consistent Git plus DVC state

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that reruns pull the exact DVC-tracked data and model objects associated with the matching Git revision so reproduction does not mix incompatible versions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Rate = successful reproductions using matching Git and DVC states / total reproduction attempts tested.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure consistent-state reproduction remains above threshold for all governed rerun tests.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: DVC's core design links Git state with externalized data and model objects, so consistency checks are central to trustworthy reproduction.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for DVC
